record.title: Prepare paired RAW exports of twenty fixed-source stock acquisitions
record.intent: Distinguish repeat-read instability from acquisition variation after the failed stock return control.
requirements: Pin the complete failed original A1, unchanged numerical interpretation, independently reproduced descriptive forensic, accepted stock epoch and last actual 100 MHz/raw-zero source-command lineage. Preserve the original failure and all twenty-five records. These new diagnostic records are not comparison slots and cannot accept A1 or B.

Create a distinct typed diagnostic schema and Linux delegate using the reviewed conventional SCPI socket, owned ADB metadata checks, recorder, isolation and full ordinary/export restoration boundaries. Remove the Mac UART/visit relay path entirely; do not fabricate a fresh source-complete envelope or open the RF source device. Source lineage is inherited command evidence, not a new physical frequency/amplitude acknowledgement.

Prepare twenty fresh count-one stopped acquisitions at original 50 mV/div, 100000 points and 4 GSa/s. For each, perform one RUN/serviced wait/STOP, enforce STOP/rate/export geometry, and collect preamble/DATA-one/preamble/DATA-two/preamble with no RUN or settings write between the two DATA replies. Preserve exact original reply bytes. Pair inequality is a diagnostic outcome; framing, geometry, range, health or deadline failure stops without resend or replacement.

Use one explicit at-most-900-second aggregate acquisition budget with separate cleanup reserve inside current authorization. Keep original range veto, no uncertain retries, full host/lease/current metadata gates, same-epoch inherited byte/policy/UI/thermal limitations, zero root/reboot/native/protected writes, complete restoration, owned helper retirement and graceful full capture/drop statistics. Supply focused offline controls and independent preparation review before specimen contact.

Preparation may inspect only preserved files and host-only state. Do not contact the specimen, start capture/DHCP/ADB/SCPI/serial, mutate networking or physical state. Admit and commit/push preparation conclusions before actual execution.
acceptance: A reviewed distinct paired-export diagnostic or its exact preparation blocker is durably pinned.
